statement: context performance degrades at every increment of context growth even on trivial tasks (Chroma 2025, 18 frontier models)
mechanism: measured degradation curve across models; also 20+ point drops on multi-document QA when relevant material sits mid-context (Liu et al.)

statement: externalizing facts to files makes them re-fetchable, bounding the effective in-window context and resisting rot
mechanism: durable external memory survives compaction; re-fetch on demand keeps window small; consistent with reorientation-cost rule (bounded state + query beats growing files)
limitation: no in-corpus incident data that this lab's 2-Action Rule caused a measurable improvement

statement: the 2-op interval is an unexplained heuristic; its value over end-of-session persistence is untested
